lines.text: Hi, can I get two rice bowls to go?
lines.speaker: Han

lines.text: One of each, please. No onions on the vegetable one.
lines.speaker: Han

lines.text: We're out of chicken. We have beef today.
lines.speaker: Pia

lines.text: Okay, one beef bowl instead. Is it spicy?
lines.speaker: Han

lines.text: A little. I can put the sauce on the side.
lines.speaker: Pia

lines.text: Please do. And one small iced tea, please.
lines.speaker: Han

lines.text: One beef, one vegetable without onions, and one small iced tea. All to go.
lines.speaker: Pia
